solutions.name: Restart mcc_server if port 8080 unreachable
solutions.notes: Kills any Python process holding port 8080 then restarts the server

solutions.name: Recreate health.db if corrupted
solutions.match_pattern: database is locked|database disk image is malformed|sqlite3.DatabaseError
solutions.notes: Backs up corrupted DB to .broken and reinitialises a fresh one

solutions.name: Restore STATUS.md from git if file shrinks below baseline
solutions.notes: Restores last known good STATUS.md from the previous commit

solutions.name: Move oldest aafl_output files to archive_dead if cap exceeded
solutions.match_pattern: aafl_output file cap exceeded|aafl_output.*too many files
fix_steps: python -c "import glob,shutil,os; files=sorted(glob.glob('aafl_output/*.txt'),key=os.path.getmtime); [shutil.move(f,'archive_dead/') for f in files[:max(0,len(files)-50)]]"
solutions.notes: Keeps newest 50 AAFL output files, moves the rest to archive_dead

solutions.name: Clear stuck_inbox.json if file is malformed JSON
solutions.notes: Backs up and resets the stuck inbox to an empty array

solutions.name: Recreate knowledge_engine.db if tables missing
solutions.notes: Backs up and recreates the knowledge bank DB with fresh schema

solutions.name: Reset promo_queue.json if malformed
solutions.notes: Resets the promo queue to empty — approved items may already be archived

solutions.name: Recreate chat_latest.txt if missing
solutions.notes: Creates an empty chat_latest.txt — WCCS will populate it on next save

solutions.name: Rebuild aafl_control_config.json if missing or malformed
solutions.notes: Rebuilds AAFL control config with safe defaults — current goal will be lost

solutions.name: Re-initialise kanban_board.json if missing
solutions.notes: Creates a blank kanban board — existing cards will be lost

solutions.name: Clear scout_output/latest.txt if oversized (>1MB)
fix_steps: python -c "open('scout_output/latest.txt','w').write('[CLEARED by self-health — file was oversized]')"
solutions.notes: Replaces an oversized scout output file with a placeholder

solutions.name: Rebuild activity_log.json if malformed
solutions.notes: Resets activity log to empty array — historical entries will be lost (backed up first)
